errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"Unauthorized: Authentication required","www-authenticate":"Bearer resource_metadata=\"https://sleeperhit.studio/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp\", scope=\"openid profile email story:read story:write source:read source:write artifact:read artifact:publish publishing:read publishing:write publishing:publish credits:read app:connect\"","hint":"Finish the sign-in where you run it, with the CLI device code (`sleeperhit login --no-browser`): it needs no callback, so it works in a chat or a sandboxed shell; if you have no shell to run it in, the same device sign-in is two keyless calls — POST /api/auth/device/code with client_id sleeperhit-cli and scope set to the scopes you need (name them, or the key is read-only) answers a user_code and a verification_uri for your user, then poll POST /api/v1/device/credential with its device_code; if your user cannot approve that, ask your user to sign in from their app and don't run the browser login yourself — only the app's browser OAuth needs a callback it cannot reach from there, and the device code never does.
